create_BasicEncoder: create a BasicEncoder neural network that extracts multi-scale features from input images with configurable stride
build_ShallowEncoder: build a ShallowEncoder with configurable normalization for lightweight feature extraction from images
test_EfficientUpdateFormer: test the EfficientUpdateFormer transformer model that updates track estimates using space and time attention blocks
